tanzania.title: Flag of Tanzania

colors.note: Represents the Indian Ocean and water resources

desc: - A yellow-fimbriated black diagonal stripe from the lower hoist to the upper fly, with green above and blue below
- Created when Tanganyika and Zanzibar merged to form Tanzania in 1964
trivia:
- The diagonal represents the path to national development
- The black represents the people; green represents the land; gold represents mineral resources; blue represents the ocean
- Tanzania adopted this flag in 1961 when it gained independence from Britain
